gloss: thank you for your help; thanks for your trouble
notes:
A polite expression acknowledging someone's effort or service. Slightly less formal than お{世話|せわ}になっております, which is the standard business greeting. Used when receiving a service or after someone has helped you.

USAGE:
Commonly said to delivery workers, maintenance staff, and service providers as a quick thank-you. Can also be used in ongoing business relationships as a semi-formal greeting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{世話様|せわさま}でした: thank you for your help (past)
- お{世話様|せわさま}です: thank you for your help (present/ongoing)
- いつもお{世話様|せわさま}です: thank you always for your help

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- お{世話|せわ}になっております: I am in your care — more formal, standard business greeting
- お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}です: thank you for your hard work — used among colleagues
- ご{苦労|くろう}{様|さま}です: thank you for your efforts — used from superior to subordinate

definitions.gloss: thank you for your help; thanks for your trouble
definitions.explanation: an expression of gratitude for someone's help or service, acknowledging the trouble they have taken

examples.japanese: お{世話様|せわさま}でした。
{配達|はいたつ}の{方|かた}にお{世話様|せわさま}と{声|こえ}をかけた。
examples.english: I called out 'thank you' to the delivery person.

examples.japanese: いつもお{世話様|せわさま}です。{本日|ほんじつ}もよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Thank you always for your help. I appreciate your assistance today as well.
